data_fields.name: speech_channels
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 priority channel (single clip at a time)

data_fields.name: positional_silence_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: none (divisor 80 implies silence at 80; not confirmed)

data_fields.name: sound_off_essential_ids
data_fields.donor_constant: ids 0 and 1 still play with sound off

best_idea: A cue id has two renderings (speech clip, else a positional sound effect), a single speech channel takes a clip only at or above the current priority, and a bed director plays one stinger per fight before calm beds with a rest gap.
decision_why: Keep the two-rendering cue id, the priority channel with positional fallback and the bed director with stinger and rest gap; fix the dropped battle state, the repeated-track no-op, the gain clamp mismatch and the speech path's missing distance; add the fade-in the donor lacks.
acceptance: In a fight, three unit alerts within 2 s start one battle stinger and the battle track plays to its end without later alerts restarting it; a priority-10 clip is never demoted by a priority-5 clip; a cue 80 tiles away is silent and one 40 tiles away plays at half gain on both the speech and sound-effect paths; a bed does not replay the track that just ended.
